contribution.position: Holding my reliability opposition. QA's claim that risk is contained by artifact:test-report does not answer production reliability: 412 passed / 0 failed and 87% coverage are pre-change evidence, while artifact:incident-log shows the live job already at 2.1% against a 0.5% SLO with two sev2 incidents. Product's statement that nobody else sees a problem is also not evidence; the incident log is the contrary datum, so adding a change now compounds an active SLO breach.
